card.name: Openers before a new word starts
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short openers where the next word begins fresh: www in web addresses, opening quotes, parentheses, equals signs and dashes. The next token is a new word, often lowercase.

modes.label: Web address start
modes.description: The www part of a URL after 'visit', 'at' or 'http://'.

modes.label: Opening quote or bracket
modes.description: An opening quote mark or parenthesis that introduces a quoted term or aside.

modes.label: Joining symbols
modes.description: An equals sign or dash that introduces a definition or explanation.

card.writes: It promotes single-letter word starts such as s, m, c and d, so it favors the beginning of a new word.
card.plain: It fires on marks like quotes, dashes and www that are followed by a new word starting up.
